panels.description: Rented maker room. Alex and Lina align the folded membrane sleeve, routing shard and salvaged heat exchanger on a crowded workbench; Suri, Jalen and Ren remain off-panel. Leave upper third clear for the coming failure.
The assembled purifier components shudder on the bench, clamps vibrating and indicator lights flickering. Keep the machine dominant and leave upper space for sound lettering.
Suri reaches in and pulls the living biofilter vial away from the failing assembly while Alex steadies the casing. Keep only Alex and Suri visible; leave upper-left clear.
Jalen's hand kills the power cycle at the routing shard while Ren's gloved hand catches the loose heat connector at frame edge. Do not show their full bodies; leave upper band clear.
